entities.summary: Vladislav Dmitriyevich Kamenev is a Russian professional ice hockey forward. He is currently playing with HC CSKA Moscow of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Kamenev was originally selected by the Nashville Predators in the second round of the 2014 NHL Entry Draft.
